description: Lists the Mapbox account's public (pk.) access tokens, for when you build a web page or app outside this chat that loads Mapbox GL JS or calls Mapbox APIs from the browser. Put the returned pk. token in the page: public tokens are made to ship in browser code, so a placeholder or asking the user to paste a token is not needed. To show a map in the chat, use render_map_tool instead; it needs no token. Pass site_url (where the page will run) to get a token restricted to that URL when the account has one. Returns each token's name, whether it is the default, its URL restrictions and scopes, a recommended token, and guidance: for a published site, use a URL-restricted token, and tell the user the default token can be reused by anyone who copies it. Secret tokens are never listed.

site_url.description: Where the page or app that will use the token is served from, for example "https://example.com" or "http://localhost:3000". Used to pick a public token that is restricted to that URL. Leave it out if you don't know yet.

name: list_public_tokens_tool

guidance.description: How to use the token safely

recommended.description: The token to use for the given site_url, and why

allowedUrls.description: URLs the token is restricted to. Empty means it works from anywhere.

default.description: Whether this is the account's default public token

note.description: The name given to the token

title: List Public Tokens
